name: devto-mcp
description: Write for dev.to with its rules checked offline, and score the prose rather than the code.
long_description: An MCP server for authorship on DEV (dev.to). Every rule the platform enforces is checked offline first, so a rejection costs no API request, and the text tools measure the prose rather than the code — each score arrives with the share of the document it was computed over. The metrics reproduce Python textstat 0.7.13 byte-for-byte over 58 documents, hyphenation matches pyphen over 20,854 words, and the reading time matches what dev.to itself reports on 30 published articles.
